1.1.d: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवं रत्वीजम | होतारं रत्नधातमम ||
1.1.e: I Laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice,  The hotar, lavishest of wealth.

1.1.d: अग्निः पूर्वेभिर्र्षिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत | स देवानेह वक्षति ||
1.1.e: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers.  He shall bring hitherward the Gods.

1.1.d: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत पोषमेव दिवे-दिवे | यशसं वीरवत्तमम ||
1.1.e: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day,  Most rich in heroes, glorious.

1.1.d: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि | स इद्देवेषु गछति ||
1.1.e: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about  Verily goeth to the Gods.

1.1.d: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः | देवो देवेभिरा गमत ||
1.1.e: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great,  The God, come hither with the Gods.

1.1.d: यदङग दाशुषे तवमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि | तवेत तत सत्यमङगिरः ||
1.1.e: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper,  That, Aṅgiras, is indeed thy truth.

1.1.d: उप तवाग्ने दिवे-दिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम | नमो भरन्त एमसि ||
1.1.e: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer  Bringing thee reverence, we come

1.1.d: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपां रतस्य दीदिविम | वर्धमानंस्वे दमे ||
1.1.e: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One,  Increasing in thine own abode.

1.1.d: स नः पितेव सूनवे.अग्ने सूपायनो भव | सचस्वा नः सवस्तये ||
1.1.e: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son:  Agni, be with us for our weal.

1.2.d: वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंक्र्ताः | तेषां पाहि शरुधी हवम ||
1.2.e: BEAUTIFUL Vāyu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared:  Drink of them, hearken to our call.

1.2.d: वाय उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते तवामछा जरितारः | सुतसोमा अहर्विदः ||
1.2.e: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify  Thee, Vāyu, with their hymns of praise.

1.2.d: वायो तव परप्र्ञ्चती धेना जिगाति दाशुषे | उरूची सोमपीतये ||
1.2.e: Vāyu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper,  Far-spreading for the Soma draught.

1.2.d: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप परयोभिरा गतम | इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि ||
1.2.e: These, Indra-Vāyu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties’ sake:  The drops are yearning for you both.

1.2.d: वायविन्द्रश्च चेतथः सुतानां वाजिनीवसू | तावा यातमुप दरवत ||
1.2.e: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vāyu and Indra, rich in spoil!  So come ye swiftly hitherward.

1.2.d: वायविन्द्रश्च सुन्वत आ यातमुप निष्क्र्तम | मक्ष्वित्था धिया नरा ||
1.2.e: Vāyu and Indra, come to what the Soma-presser hath prepared:  Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.

1.2.d: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम | धियं घर्ताचीं साधन्ता ||
1.2.e: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuṇa,  Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

1.2.d: रतेन मित्रावरुणाव रताव्र्धाव रतस्प्र्शा | करतुं बर्हन्तमाशाथे ||
1.2.e: Mitra and Varuṇa, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law,  Have ye obtained your might power

1.2.d: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया | दक्षं दधाते अपसम ||
1.2.e: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuṇa, wide dominion, strong by birth,  Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.

1.3.d: अश्विना यज्वरीरिषो दरवत्पाणी शुभस पती | पुरुभुजाचनस्यतम ||
1.3.e: YE Aśvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands,  Accept the sacrificial food.

1.3.d: अश्विना पुरुदंससा नरा शवीरया धिया | धिष्ण्या वनतं गिरः ||
1.3.e: Ye Aśvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise,  Accept our songs with mighty thought.

1.3.d: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वर्क्तबर्हिषः | आ यातंरुद्रवर्तनी ||
1.3.e: Nāsatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass:  Come ye whose paths are red with flame.

1.3.d: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे तवायवः | अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ||
1.3.e: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee,  Thus by fine fingers purified.

1.3.d: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः | उप बरह्माणि वाघतः ||
1.3.e: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers,  Of the libation-pouring priest.

1.3.d: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप बरह्माणि हरिवः | सुते दधिष्वनश्चनः ||
1.3.e: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers.  In our libation take delight.

1.3.d: ओमासश्चर्षणीध्र्तो विश्वे देवास आ गत | दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतम ||
1.3.e: Ye Viśvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach  Your worshipper's drink-offering.

1.3.d: विश्वे देवासो अप्तुरः सुतमा गन्त तूर्णयः | उस्रा इवस्वसराणि ||
1.3.e: Ye Viśvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught,  As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.

1.3.d: विश्वे देवासो अस्रिध एहिमायासो अद्रुहः | मेधं जुषन्त वह्नयः ||
1.3.e: The Viśvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile,  Bearers, accept the sacred draught

1.3.d: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती | यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ||
1.3.e: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright  Sarasvatī  desire,  With eager love, our sacrifice.

1.3.d: चोदयित्री सून्र्तानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम | यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती ||
1.3.e: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer of all gracious thought,  Sarasvatī accept our rite

1.3.d: महो अर्णः सरस्वती पर चेतयति केतुना | धियो विश्वा वि राजति ||
1.3.e: Sarasvatī, the mighty flood,—she with her light illuminates,  She brightens every pious thought.

1.4.e: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds,  To our assistance day by day.

1.4.d: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब | गोदा इद रेवतोमदः ||
1.4.e: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou!  The rich One's rapture giveth kine.

1.4.d: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम | मा नो अति खय आगहि ||
1.4.e: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence:  Neglect us not, come hitherward.

1.4.d: परेहि विग्रमस्त्र्तमिन्द्रं पर्छा विपश्चितम | यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरम ||
1.4.e: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song,  Him who is better than thy friends.

1.4.d: उत बरुवन्तु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत | दधाना इन्द्र इद दुवः ||
1.4.e: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place,  Ye who serve Indra and none else;

1.4.d: उत नः सुभगानरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कर्ष्टयः | सयामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मणि ||
1.4.e: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest,  Still may we dwell in Indra's care.

1.4.d: एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नर्मादनम | पतयन मन्दयत्सखम ||
1.4.e: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice,  That to the Friend gives wings and joy.

1.4.d: अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वर्त्राणामभवः | परावो वाजेषु वाजिनम ||
1.4.e: Thou, Śatakratu, drankest this and wast the Vṛtras’ slayer; thou  Helpest the warrior in the fray.

1.4.d: तं तवा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो | धनानामिन्द्र सातये ||
1.4.e: We strengthen, Śatakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight,  That, Indra, we may win us wealth.

1.4.d: यो रायो.अवनिर्महान सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा | तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ||
1.4.e: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice,  Yea, to this Indra sing your song.

1.5.d: आ तवेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि पर गायत | सखाय सतोमवाहसः ||
1.5.e: O COME ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song,  companions, bringing hymns of praise.

1.5.d: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम | इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ||
1.5.e: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent,  Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.

1.5.d: स घा नो योग आ भुवत स राये स पुरन्ध्याम | गमद वाजेभिरा स नः ||
1.5.e: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth:  May he come nigh us with his strength.

1.5.d: यस्य संस्थे न वर्ण्वते हरी समत्सु शत्रवः | तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ||
1.5.e: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not:  To him, to Indra sing your song.

1.5.d: सुतपाव्ने सुता इमे शुचयो यन्ति वीतये | सोमासो दध्याशिरः ||
1.5.e: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops,  The Somas mingled with the curd.

1.5.d: तवं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वर्द्धो अजायथाः | इन्द्र जयैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो ||
1.5.e: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice,  Strong Indra, for preëminence.

1.5.d: आ तवा विशन्त्वाशवः सोमास इन्द्र गिर्वणः | शं ते सन्तु परचेतसे ||
1.5.e: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee:  May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.

1.5.d: तवां सतोमा अवीव्र्धन तवामुक्था शतक्रतो | तवां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ||
1.5.e: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Śatakratu, and our lauds  So strengthen thee the songs we sing.

1.5.d: अक्षितोतिः सनेदिमं वाजमिन्द्रः सहस्रिणम | यस्मिन विश्वानि पौंस्या ||
1.5.e: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold,  Wherein all manly powers abide.

1.5.d: मा नो मर्ता अभि दरुहन तनूनामिन्द्र गिर्वणः | ईशानो यवया वधम ||
1.5.e: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep  Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.

1.6.d: युञ्जन्ति बरध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः | रोचन्तेरोचना दिवि ||
1.6.e: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed  The lights are shining in the sky.

1.6.d: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे | शोणा धर्ष्णू नर्वाहसा ||
1.6.e: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him,  Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.

1.6.d: केतुं कर्ण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे | समुषद्भिरजायथाः ||
1.6.e: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not,  Wast born together with the Dawns.
Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn,  Assuming sacrificial names.

1.6.d: वीळु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः | अविन्द उस्रिया अनु ||
1.6.e: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm,  Foundest the kine even in the cave.

1.6.d: देवयन्तो यथा मतिमछा विदद्वसुं गिरः | महामनूषत शरुतम ||
1.6.e: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth,  The far-renowned, the mighty One.

1.6.d: इन्द्रेण सं हि दर्क्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा | मन्दू समानवर्चसा ||
1.6.e: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side:  Both joyous, equal in your sheen.
With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven,  The sacrificer cries aloud.

1.6.d: अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि | समस्मिन्न्र्ञ्जते गिरः ||
1.6.e: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven:  Our songs of praise all yearn for this.

1.6.d: इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि | इन्द्रं महोवा रजसः ||
1.6.e: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth,  Or from the spacious firmament.

1.7.e: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds,  Indra the choirs have glorified.

1.7.d: इन्द्र इद धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा | इन्द्रो वज्रीहिरण्ययः ||
1.7.e: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car,  Indra the golden, thunder-armed.

1.7.d: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद दिवि | वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत ||
1.7.e: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar:  He burst the mountain for the kine.

1.7.d: इन्द्र वाजेषु नो.अव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च | उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ||
1.7.e: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained,  With awful aids, O awful One.

1.7.d: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे | युजं वर्त्रेषु वज्रिणम ||
1.7.e: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight,  The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

1.7.d: स नो वर्षन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वर्धि | अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ||
1.7.e: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud,  For us, thou irresistible.

1.7.d: तुञ्जे-तुञ्जे य उत्तरे सतोमा इन्द्रस्य वज्रिणः | न विन्धेस्य सुष्टुतिम ||
1.7.e: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise:  I find no laud worthy of him.

1.7.d: वर्षा यूथेव वंसगः कर्ष्टीरियर्त्योजसा | ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ||
1.7.e: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might,  The Ruler irresistible:

1.7.d: य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति | इन्द्रः पञ्च कसितीनाम ||
1.7.e: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race  Of those who dwell upon the earth.

1.7.d: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः | अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ||
1.7.e: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men:  Ours, and none others’, may he be.

1.8.d: एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहम | वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ||
1.8.e: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth,  Most excellent, to be our aid;

1.8.d: नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वर्त्रा रुणधामहै | तवोतासो नयर्वता ||
1.8.e: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand,  By thee assisted with the car.

1.8.d: इन्द्र तवोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि | जयेम सं युधि सप्र्धः ||
1.8.e: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt,  And conquer all our foes in fight.

1.8.d: वयं शूरेभिरस्त्र्भिरिन्द्र तवया युजा वयम | सासह्याम पर्तन्यतः ||
1.8.e: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may  We conquer our embattled foes.

1.8.d: महानिन्द्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे | दयौर्नप्रथिना शवः ||
1.8.e: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer:  Wide as the heaven extends his power

1.8.d: समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ | विप्रासो वा धियायवः ||
1.8.e: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight,  Or singers loving holy thoughts.

1.8.d: यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्र इव पिन्वते | उर्वीरापो न काकुदः ||
1.8.e: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells,  Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.

1.8.d: एवा हयस्य सून्र्ता विरप्शी गोमती मही | पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे ||
1.8.e: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like  A ripe branch to the worshipper.

1.8.d: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते | सद्यश्चित सन्तिदाशुषे ||
1.8.e: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once  Unto a worshipper like me.

1.8.d: एवा हयस्य काम्या सतोम उक्थं च शंस्या | इन्द्राय सोमपीतये ||
1.8.e: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung,  That he may drink the Soma juice.

1.9.e: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts,  Protector, mighty in thy strength.

1.9.d: एमेनं सर्जता सुते मन्दिमिन्द्राय मन्दिने | चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये ||
1.9.e: To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him  The gladdening, omnific God.
O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds,  Present at these drink-offerings.

1.9.d: अस्र्ग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः परति तवामुदहासत | अजोषा वर्षभं पतिम ||
1.9.e: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord,  And raised themselves unsatisfied.

1.9.d: सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग राध इन्द्र वरेण्यम | असदित ते विभु परभु ||
1.9.e: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of our wish,  For power supreme is only thine.

1.9.d: अस्मान सु तत्र चोदयेन्द्र राये रभस्वतः | तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः ||
1.9.e: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth,  And glorious, O most splendid One.

1.9.d: सं गोमदिन्द्र वाजवदस्मे पर्थु शरवो बर्हत | विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितम ||
1.9.e: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength,  Lasting our life-time, failing not.

1.9.d: अस्मे धेहि शरवो बर्हद दयुम्नं सहस्रसातमम | इन्द्र ता रथिनीरिषः ||
1.9.e: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those  Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.

1.9.d: वसोरिन्द्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्ग्र्णन्त रग्मियम | होम गन्तारमूतये ||
1.9.e: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call  Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.

1.9.d: सुते-सुते नयोकसे बर्हद बर्हत एदरिः | इन्द्राय शूषमर्चति ||
1.9.e: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man  Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.

1.10.d: गायन्ति तवा गायत्रिणो.अर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः | बरह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद वंशमिव येमिरे ||
1.10.e: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee.  The priests have raised thee up on high, O Śatakratu, like a pole.

1.10.d: यत सानोः सानुमारुहद भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वम | तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वर्ष्णिरेजति ||
1.10.e: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task,  Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.

1.10.d: युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वर्षणा कक्ष्यप्रा | अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ||
1.10.e: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths,  And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.

1.10.d: एहि सतोमानभि सवराभि गर्णीह्या रुव | बरह्म च नो वसोसचेन्द्र यज्ञं च वर्धय ||
1.10.e: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud.  Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.

1.10.d: उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे | शक्रो यथा सुतेषु णो रारणत सख्येषु च ||
1.10.e: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives,  That Śakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.

1.10.d: तमित सखित्व ईमहे तं राये तं सुवीर्ये | स शक्र उत नः शकदिन्द्रो वसु दयमानः ||
1.10.e: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might.  For Indra, he is Śakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.

1.10.d: सुविव्र्तं सुनिरजमिन्द्र तवादातमिद यशः | गवामपव्रजं वर्धि कर्णुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ||
1.10.e: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee.  Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed

1.10.d: नहि तवा रोदसी उभे रघायमाणमिन्वतः | जेषः सवर्वतीरपः सं गा अस्मभ्यं धूनुहि ||
1.10.e: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood.  Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.

1.10.d: आश्रुत्कर्ण शरुधी हवं नू चिद दधिष्व मे गिरः | इन्द्र सतोममिमं मम कर्ष्वा युजश्चिदन्तरम ||
1.10.e: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs  O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.

1.10.d: विद्मा हि तवा वर्षन्तमं वाजेषु हवनश्रुतम | वर्षन्तमस्य हूमह ऊतिं सहस्रसातमाम ||
1.10.e: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry.  Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.

1.10.d: आ तू न इन्द्र कौशिक मन्दसानः सुतं पिब | नव्यमायुःप्र सू तिर कर्धी सहस्रसां रषिम ||
1.10.e: O Indra, Son of Kuśika, drink our libation with delight.  Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.

1.10.d: परि तवा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतः | वर्द्धायुमनु वर्द्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयः ||
1.10.e: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee:  Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.

1.11.d: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीव्र्धन समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः | रथीतमंरथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम ||
1.11.e: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea,  The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.

1.11.d: सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस पते | तवामभि परणोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम ||
1.11.e: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear.  We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.

1.11.d: पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः | यदी वाजस्य गोमत सतोत्र्भ्यो मंहते मघम ||
1.11.e: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail,  When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.

1.11.d: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत | इन्द्रो विश्वस्यकर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ||
1.11.e: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born  Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.

1.11.d: तवं वलस्य गोमतो.अपावरद्रिवो बिलम | तवां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ||
1.11.e: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows.  The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,

1.11.d: तवाहं शूर रातिभिः परत्यायं सिन्धुमावदन | उपातिष्ठन्त गिर्वणो विदुष टे तस्य कारवः ||
1.11.e: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee.  Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.

1.11.d: मायाभिरिन्द्र मायिनं तवं शुष्णमवातिरः | विदुष टे तस्य मेधिरास्तेषां शरवांस्युत तिर ||
1.11.e: The wily Śuṣṇa, Indra! thou o’erthrewest with thy wondrous powers.  The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.

1.11.d: इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि सतोमा अनूषत | सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः ||
1.11.e: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might,  Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.

1.12.d: अग्निं दूतं वर्णीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम | अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम ||
1.12.e: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth,  Well skilled in this our sacrifice.

1.12.d: अग्निम-अग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम | हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम ||
1.12.e: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House,  Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

1.12.d: अग्ने देवानिहा वह जज्ञानो वर्क्तबर्हिषे | असि होता न ईड्यः ||
1.12.e: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass:  Thou art our herald, meet for praise.

1.12.d: तानुशतो वि बोधय यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम | देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ||
1.12.e: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage:  Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.

1.12.d: घर्ताहवन दीदिवः परति षम रिषतो दह | अग्ने तवं रक्षस्विनः ||
1.12.e: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up  Our enemies whom fiends protect.
By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears  The gift: the ladle is his mouth.
Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true,  The God who driveth grief away.

1.12.d: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति | तस्य सम पराविता भव ||
1.12.e: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts,  Worshippeth thee the messenger.

1.12.d: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्मानाविवासति | तस्मै पावक मर्ळय ||
1.12.e: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods,  O Purifier, favour him.

1.12.d: स नः पावक दीदिवो.अग्ने देवानिहा वह | उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः ||
1.12.e: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice,  To our oblation bring the Gods.

1.12.d: स न सतवान आ भर गायत्रेण नवीयसा | रयिं वीरवतीमिषम ||
1.12.e: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us,  And food, with heroes for our sons.

1.12.d: अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा विश्वाभिर्देवहूतिभिः | इमं सतोमं जुषस्व नः ||
1.12.e: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods,  Show pleasure in this laud of ours.

1.13.d: सुसमिद्धो न आ वह देवानग्ने हविष्मते | होतः पावक यक्षि च ||
1.13.e: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts.  Worship them, Purifier, Priest.

1.13.d: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे | अद्या कर्णुहि वीतये ||
1.13.e: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today.  Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.

1.13.d: नराशंसमिह परियमस्मिन यज्ञ उप हवये | मधुजिह्वंहविष्क्र्तम ||
1.13.e: Dear Narāśaṁsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I  Invoke to this our sacrifice.

1.13.d: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवानीळित आ वह | असि होता मनुर्हितः ||
1.13.e: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods:  Manu appointed thee as Priest.

1.13.d: सत्र्णीत बर्हिरानुषग घर्तप्र्ष्ठं मनीषिणः | यत्राम्र्तस्य चक्षणम ||
1.13.e: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due,  Where the Immortal is beheld.

1.13.d: वि शरयन्तां रताव्र्धो दवारो देवीरसश्चतः | अद्या नूनं च यष्टवे ||
1.13.e: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite,  For sacrifice this day and now.

1.13.d: नक्तोषासा सुपेशसास्मिन यज्ञ उप हवये | इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ||
1.13.e: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass  At this our solemn sacrifice.

1.13.d: ता सुजिह्वा उप हवये होतारा दैव्या कवी | यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम ||
1.13.e: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue,  To celebrate this our sacrifice.

1.13.d: इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः | बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः ||
1.13.e: Iḷā, Sarasvatī, Mahī, three Goddesses who bring delight,  Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.
Tvaṣṭar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will:  May he be ours and ours alone.

1.13.d: अव सर्जा वनस्पते देव देवेभ्यो हविः | पर दातुरस्तु चेतनम ||
1.13.e: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods,  And let the giver be renowned.

1.13.d: सवाहा यज्ञं कर्णोतनेन्द्राय यज्वनो गर्हे | तत्र देवानुप हवये ||
1.13.e: With Svāhā pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house:  Thither I call the Deities.

1.14.d: ऐभिरग्ने दुवो गिरो विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये | देवेभिर्याहि यक्षि च ||
1.14.e: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs.  With all these Gods; and worship them.

1.14.d: आ तवा कण्वा अहूषत गर्णन्ति विप्र ते धियः | देवेभिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.14.e: The Kaṇvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise  Agni, come hither with the Gods;

1.14.d: इन्द्रवायू बर्हस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगम | आदित्यान्मारुतं गणम ||
1.14.e: Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pūṣan, Bhaga,  Ādityas, and the Marut host.

1.14.d: पर वो भरियन्त इन्दवो मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः | दरप्सा मध्वश्चमूषदः ||
1.14.e: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate,  The meath-drops resting in the cup.
The sons of Kaṇva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass,  With offerings and all things prepared.

1.14.d: घर्तप्र्ष्ठा मनोयुजो ये तवा वहन्ति वह्नयः | आ देवान सोमपीतये ||
1.14.e: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil,  Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.

1.14.d: तान यजत्रान रताव्र्धो.अग्ने पत्नीवतस कर्धि | मध्वः सुजिह्व पायय ||
1.14.e: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames:  Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.

1.14.d: ये यजत्रा य ईड्यास्ते ते पिबन्तु जिह्वया | मधोरग्ने वषट्क्र्ति ||
1.14.e: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue  The meath in solemn sacrifice.

1.14.d: आकीं सूर्यस्य रोचनाद विश्वान देवानुषर्बुधः | विप्रो होतेह वक्षति ||
1.14.e: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring  All Gods awaking with the dawn.

1.14.d: विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इन्द्रेण वायुना | पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः ||
1.14.e: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vāyu, and Mitra's splendours, drink,  Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.

1.14.d: तवं होता मनुर्हितो.अग्ने यज्ञेषु सीदसि | सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ||
1.14.e: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite:  Hallow thou this our sacrifice.

1.14.d: युक्ष्वा हयरुषी रथे हरितो देव रोहितः | ताभिर्देवानिहा वह ||
1.14.e: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones:  With those bring hitherward the Gods.

1.15.d: इन्द्र सोमं पिब रतुना तवा विशन्त्विन्दवः | मत्सरासस्तदोकसः ||
1.15.e: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Ṛtu; let the cheering drops  Sink deep within, which settle there.

1.15.d: मरुतः पिबत रतुना पोत्राद यज्ञं पुनीतन | यूयं हि षठा सुदानवः ||
1.15.e: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Ṛtu; sanctify  The rite, for ye give precious gifts.

1.15.d: अभि यज्ञं गर्णीहि नो गनावो नेष्टः पिब रतुना | तवंहि रत्नधा असि ||
1.15.e: O Neṣṭar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Ṛtu drink,  For thou art he who giveth wealth.

1.15.d: अग्ने देवानिहा वह सादया योनिषु तरिषु | परि भूष पिब रतुना ||
1.15.e: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down:  Surround them, and with Ṛtu drink.

1.15.d: बराह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोमं रतून्रनु | तवेद धि सख्यमस्त्र्तम ||
1.15.e: Drink Soma after the Ṛtus, from the Brāhmaṇa's bounty: undissolved,  O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.

1.15.d: युवं दक्षं धर्तव्रत मित्रावरुण दूळभम | रतुना यज्ञमाशाथे ||
1.15.e: Mitra, Varuṇa, ye whose ways are firm—a Power that none deceives—,  With Ṛtu ye have reached the rite.

1.15.d: दरविणोदा दरविणसो गरावहस्तासो अध्वरे | यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ||
1.15.e: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite,  In sacrifices praise the God.

1.15.d: दरविणोदा ददातु नो वसूनि यानि शर्ण्विरे | देवेषु ता वनामहे ||
1.15.e: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned.  These things we gain, among the Gods.

1.15.d: दरविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत पर च तिष्ठत | नेष्ट्राद रतुभिरिष्यत ||
1.15.e: He with the Ṛtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Neṣṭar's bowl.  Haste, give your offering, and depart.

1.15.d: यत तवा तुरीयं रतुभिर्द्रविणोदो यजामहे | अध समा नो ददिर्भव ||
1.15.e: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Ṛtus, be  A Giver bountiful to us.

1.15.d: अश्विना पिबतं मधु दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रत | रतुना यज्ञवाहसा ||
1.15.e: Drink ye the meath, O Aśvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who with  Ṛtus accept the sacrifice.

1.15.d: गार्हपत्येन सन्त्य रतुना यज्ञनीरसि | देवान देवयते यज ||
1.15.e: With Ṛtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice:  Worship the Gods for the pious man.

1.16.d: आ तवा वहन्तु हरयो वर्षणं सोमपीतये | इन्द्र तवा सूरचक्षसः ||
1.16.e: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught—  Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.

1.16.d: इमा धाना घर्तस्नुवो हरी इहोप वक्षतः | इन्द्रं सुखतमे रथे ||
1.16.e: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring  Indra upon his easiest car.

1.16.d: इन्द्रं परातर्हवामह इन्द्रं परयत्यध्वरे | इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ||
1.16.e: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice,  Indra to drink the Soma juice.

1.16.d: उप नः सुतमा गहि हरिभिरिन्द्र केशिभिः | सुते हि तवाहवामहे ||
1.16.e: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to he draught we pour  We call thee when the juice is shed.

1.16.d: सेमं न सतोमं आ गह्युपेदं सवनं सुतम | गौरो नत्र्षितः पिब ||
1.16.e: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee  Drink of it like a stag athirst.

1.16.d: इमे सोमास इन्दवः सुतासो अधि बर्हिषि | तानिन्द्र सहसेपिब ||
1.16.e: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof  Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.

1.16.d: अयं ते सतोमो अग्रियो हर्दिस्प्र्गस्तु शन्तमः | अथा सोमंसुतं पिब ||
1.16.e: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent:  Then drink the Soma juice expressed.

1.16.d: विश्वमित सवनं सुतमिन्द्रो मदाय गछति | वर्त्रहा सोमपीतये ||
1.16.e: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vṛtra-slayer, comes,  To drink the Soma for delight.

1.16.d: सेमं नः काममा पर्ण गोभिरश्वैः शतक्रतो | सतवाम तवा सवाध्यः ||
1.16.e: Fulfil, O Śatakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine:  With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.

1.17.d: इन्द्रावरुणयोरहं सम्राजोरव आ वर्णे | ता नो मर्ळातीद्र्शे ||
1.17.e: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuṇa; may they  Both favour one of us like me.

1.17.d: गन्तारा हि सथो.अवसे हवं विप्रस्य मावतः | धर्ताराचर्षणीनाम ||
1.17.e: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call  Of every singer such as I.

1.17.d: अनुकामं तर्पयेथामिन्द्रावरुण राय आ | ता वां नेदिष्ठमीमहे ||
1.17.e: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuṇa, with wealth:  Fain would we have you nearest us.

1.17.d: युवाकु हि शचीनां युवाकु सुमतीनाम | भूयाम वाजदाव्नाम ||
1.17.e: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence  Of you who give strength bounteously.
Indra and Varuṇa, among givers of thousands, meet for praise,  Are Powers who merit highest laud.

1.17.d: तयोरिदवसा वयं सनेम नि च धीमहि | सयादुत पररेचनम ||
1.17.e: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up  Enough and still to spare, be ours.

1.17.d: इन्द्रावरुण वामहं हुवे चित्राय राधसे | अस्मान सु जिग्युषस कर्तम ||
1.17.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, on you for wealth in many a form I call:  Still keep ye us victorious.

1.17.d: इन्द्रावरुण नू नु वां सिषासन्तीषु धीष्वा | अस्मभ्यं शर्म यछतम ||
1.17.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves,  Give us at once your sheltering help.

1.17.d: पर वामश्नोतु सुष्टुतिरिन्द्रावरुण यां हुवे | यां रधाथे सधस्तुतिम ||
1.17.e: O Indra-Varuṇa, to you may fair praise which I offer come,  Joint eulogy which ye dignify.

1.18.d: सोमानं सवरणं कर्णुहि बरह्मणस पते | कक्षीवन्तं याुशिजः ||
1.18.e: O BRĀHMAṆASPATI, make him who presses Soma glorious,  Even Kakṣīvān Auśija.

1.18.d: यो रेवान यो अमीवहा वसुवित पुष्टिवर्धनः | स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः ||
1.18.e: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store,  The prompt,—may he be with us still.

1.18.d: मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः परणं मर्त्यस्य | रक्षा णो बरह्मणस पते ||
1.18.e: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us  Preserve us, Brahmaṇaspati.

1.18.d: स घा वीरो न रिष्यति यमिन्द्रो बरह्मणस पतिः | सोमो हिनोति मर्त्यम ||
1.18.e: Ne’er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati,  And Soma graciously inspire.

1.18.d: तवं तं बरह्मणस पते सोम इन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम | दक्षिणा पात्वंहसः ||
1.18.e: Do, thou, O Brahmaṇaspati, and Indra, Soma, Dakṣiṇā,  Preserve that mortal from distress.

1.18.d: सदसस पतिमद्भुतं परियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम | सनिं मेधामयासिषम ||
1.18.e: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives  Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.

1.18.d: यस्माद रते न सिध्यति यज्ञो विपश्चितश्चन | स धीनां योगमिन्वति ||
1.18.e: He without whom no sacrifice, e’en of the wise man, prospers; he  Stirs up the series of thoughts.

1.18.d: आद रध्नोति हविष्क्र्तिं पराञ्चं कर्णोत्यध्वरम | होत्रा देवेषु गछति ||
1.18.e: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice:  Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.
I have seen Narāśaṁsa, him most resolute, most widely famed,  As ’twere the Household Priest of heaven.

1.19.d: परति तयं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय पर हूयसे | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked:  O Agni, with the Maruts come.

1.19.d: नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस्तव करतुं परः | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one:  O Agni, with the Maruts come:

1.19.d: ये महो रजसो विदुर्विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air:  O Agni, with those Maruts come.

1.19.d: य उग्रा अर्कमान्र्चुरनाध्र्ष्टास ओजसा | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might:  O Agni, with those Maruts come.

1.19.d: ये शुभ्रा घोरवर्पसः सुक्षत्रासो रिशादसः | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes:  O Agni, with those Maruts come.

1.19.d: ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere:  O Agni, with those Maruts come.

1.19.d: य ईङखयन्ति पर्वतान तिरः समुद्रमर्णवम | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea:  O Agni, with those Maruts come.

1.19.d: आ ये तन्वन्ति रश्मिभिस्तिरः समुद्रमोजसा | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might  O Agni, with those Maruts come.

1.19.d: अभि तवा पूर्वपीतये सर्जामि सोम्यं मधु | मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ||
1.19.e: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath:  O Agni, with the Maruts come.

1.20.d: अयं देवाय जन्मने सतोमो विप्रेभिरासया | अकारि रत्नधातमः ||
1.20.e: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly  Was made by singers with their lips.

1.20.d: य इन्द्राय वचोयुजा ततक्षुर्मनसा हरी | शमीभिर्यज्ञमाशत ||
1.20.e: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word,  Attained by works to sacrifice.

1.20.d: तक्षन नासत्याभ्यां परिज्मानं सुखं रथम | तक्षन धेनुं सबर्दुघाम ||
1.20.e: They for the two Nāsatyas wrought a light car moving every way:  They formed a nectar-yielding cow.

1.20.d: युवाना पितरा पुनः सत्यमन्त्रा रजूयवः | रभवो विष्ट्यक्रत ||
1.20.e: The Ṛbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made  Their Sire and Mother young again.

1.20.d: सं वो मदासो अग्मतेन्द्रेण च मरुत्वता | आदित्येभिश्च राजभिः ||
1.20.e: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt,  With the Ādityas, with the Kings.

1.20.d: उत तयं चमसं नवं तवष्टुर्देवस्य निष्क्र्तम | अकर्तचतुरः पुनः ||
1.20.e: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvaṣṭar's hand—  Four ladles have ye made thereof.

1.20.d: ते नो रत्नानि धत्तन तरिरा साप्तानि सुन्वते | एकम-एकंसुशस्तिभिः ||
1.20.e: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each  Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.

1.20.d: अधारयन्त वह्नयो.अभजन्त सुक्र्त्यया | भागं देवेषु यज्ञियम ||
1.20.e: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves,  A share in sacrifice with Gods.

1.21.d: इहेन्द्राग्नी उप हवये तयोरित सतोममुश्मसि | ता सोमं सोमपातमा ||
1.21.e: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise:  Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.

1.21.d: ता यज्ञेषु पर शंसतेन्द्राग्नी शुम्भता नरः | ता गायत्रेषु गायत ||
1.21.e: Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites:  Sing praise to them in sacred songs.

1.21.d: ता मित्रस्य परशस्तय इन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे | सोमपा सोमपीतये ||
1.21.e: Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fame  Of Mitra, to the Soma-draught.

1.21.d: उग्रा सन्ता हवामह उपेदं सवनं सुतम | इन्द्राग्नी एह गछताम ||
1.21.e: Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here:  Indra and Agni, come to us.

1.21.d: ता महान्ता सदस्पती इन्द्राग्नी रक्ष उब्जतम | अप्रजाःसन्त्वत्रिणः ||
1.21.e: Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends:  Childless be the devouring ones.

1.21.d: तेन सत्येन जाग्र्तमधि परचेतुने पदे | इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यछतम ||
1.21.e: Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious view  Indra and Agni, send us bliss.

1.22.d: परातर्युजा वि बोधयाश्विनावेह गछताम | अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ||
1.22.e: WAKEN the Aśvin Pair who yoke their car at early morn: may they  Approach to drink this Soma juice.

1.22.d: या सुरथा रथीतमोभा देवा दिविस्प्र्शा | अश्विना ता हवामहे ||
1.22.e: We call the Aśvins Twain, the Gods borne in a noble car, the best  Of charioteers, who reach the heavens.

1.22.d: या वां कशा मधुमत्यश्विना सून्र्तावती | तया यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम ||
1.22.e: Dropping with honey is your whip, Aśvins, and full of pleasantness  Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice.

1.22.d: नहि वामस्ति दूरके यत्रा रथेन गछथः | अश्विना सोमिनो गर्हम ||
1.22.e: As ye go thither in your car, not far, O Aśvins, is the home  Of him who offers Soma juice.

1.22.d: हिरण्यपाणिमूतये सवितारमुप हवये | स चेत्ता देवतापदम ||
1.22.e: For my protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar.  He knoweth, as a God, the place.

1.22.d: अपां नपातमवसे सवितारमुप सतुहि | तस्य वरतान्युश्मसि ||
1.22.e: That he may send us succour, praise the Waters’ Offspring Savitar:  Fain are we for his holy ways.

1.22.d: विभक्तारं हवामहे वसोश्चित्रस्य राधसः | सवितारंन्र्चक्षसम ||
1.22.e: We call on him, distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth,  On Savitar who looks on men.

1.22.d: सखाय आ नि षीदत सविता सतोम्यो नु नः | दाता राधांसि शुम्भति ||
1.22.e: Come hither, friends, and seat yourselves Savitar, to be praised by us,  Giving good gifts, is beautiful.

1.22.d: अग्ने पत्नीरिहा वह देवानामुशतीरुप | तवष्टारं सोमपीतये ||
1.22.e: O Agni, hither bring to us the willing Spouses of the Gods,  And Tvaṣṭar, to the Soma draught.

1.22.d: आ गना अग्न इहावसे होत्रां यविष्ठ भारतीम | वरूत्रीं धिषणां वह ||
1.22.e: Most youthful Agni, hither bring their Spouses, Hotrā, Bhāratī,  Varūtrī, Dhiṣaṇā, for aid.

1.22.d: अभी नो देवीरवसा महः शर्मणा नर्पत्नीः | अछिन्नपत्राः सचन्ताम ||
1.22.e: Spouses of Heroes, Goddesses, with whole wings may they come to us  With great protection and with aid.

1.22.d: इहेन्द्राणीमुप हवये वरुणानीं सवस्तये | अग्नायीं सोमपीतये ||
1.22.e: Indrāṇī, Varuṇānī, and Agnāyī hither I invite,  For weal, to drink the Soma juice.

1.22.d: मही दयौः पर्थिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम | पिप्र्तां नो भरीमभिः ||
1.22.e: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, bedew for us our sacrifice,  And feed us full with nourishments.

1.22.d: तयोरिद घर्तवत पयो विप्रा रिहन्ति धीतिभिः | गन्धर्वस्य धरुवे पदे ||
1.22.e: Their water rich with fatness, there in the Gandharva's steadfast place,  The singers taste through sacred songs.

1.22.d: सयोना पर्थिवि भवान्र्क्षरा निवेशनी | यछा नः शर्म सप्रथः ||
1.22.e: Thornless be thou, O Earth, spread wide before us for a dwelling-place:  Vouchsafe us shelter broad and sure.

1.22.d: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे | पर्थिव्याः सप्तधामभिः ||
1.22.e: The Gods be gracious unto us even from the place whence Viṣṇu strode  Through the seven regions of the earth!

1.22.d: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे तरेधा नि दधे पदम | समूळ्हमस्य पांसुरे ||
1.22.e: Through all this world strode Viṣṇu; thrice his foot he planted, and the whole  Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

1.22.d: तरीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः | अतो धर्माणि धारयन ||
1.22.e: Viṣṇu, the Guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps; thenceforth  Establishing his high decrees.

1.22.d: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो वरतानि पस्पशे | इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ||
1.22.e: Look ye on Viṣṇu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied,  Hath let his holy ways be seen.

1.22.d: तद विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः | दिवीव चक्षुराततम ||
1.22.e: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Viṣṇu is,  Laid as it were an eye in heaven.

1.22.d: तद विप्रासो विपन्यवो जाग्र्वांसः समिन्धते | विष्णोर्यत परमं पदम ||
1.22.e: This, Viṣṇu's station most sublime, the singers, ever vigilant,  Lovers of holy song, light up.

1.23.d: तीव्राः सोमास आ गह्याशीर्वन्तः सुता इमे | वायो तान परस्थितान पिब ||
1.23.e: STRONG are the Somas; come thou nigh; these juices have been mixt with milk:  Drink, Vāyu, the presented draughts.

1.23.d: उभा देवा दिविस्प्र्शेन्द्रवायू हवामहे | अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ||
1.23.e: Both Deities who touch the heaven, Indra and Vāyu we invoke  To drink of this our Soma juice.

1.23.d: इन्द्रवायू मनोजुवा विप्रा हवन्त ऊतये | सहस्राक्षा धियस पती ||
1.23.e: The singers' for their aid, invoke Indra and Vāyu, swift as mind,  The thousand-eyed, the Lords of thought.

1.23.d: मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये | जज्ञाना पूतदक्षसा ||
1.23.e: Mitra and Varuṇa, renowned as Gods of consecrated might,  We call to drink the Soma juice.

1.23.d: रतेन याव रताव्र्धाव रतस्य जयोतिषस पती | ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे ||
1.23.e: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law,  Mitra I call, and Varuṇa.

1.23.d: वरुणः पराविता भुवन मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः | करतां नः सुराधसः ||
1.23.e: Let Varuṇa be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids  Both make us rich exceedingly.

1.23.d: मरुत्वन्तं हवामह इन्द्रमा सोमपीतये | सजूर्गणेन तरिम्पतु ||
1.23.e: Indra, by Maruts girt, we call to drink the Soma juice: may he  Sate him in union with his troop.

1.23.d: इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुद्गणा देवासः पूषरातयः | विश्वे मम शरुता हवम ||
1.23.e: Gods, Marut hosts whom Indra leads, distributers of Pūṣan's gifts,  Hearken ye all unto my cry.

1.23.d: हत वर्त्रं सुदानव इन्द्रेण सहसा युजा | मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ||
1.23.e: With conquering Indra for ally, strike Vṛtra down, ye bounteous Gods  Let not the wicked master us.

1.23.d: विश्वान देवान हवामहे मरुतः सोमपीतये | उग्रा हि पर्श्निमातरः ||
1.23.e: We call the Universal Gods, and Maruts to the Soma draught,  For passing strong are Pṛśni's Sons.

1.23.d: जयतामिव तन्यतुर्मरुतामेति धर्ष्णुया | यच्छुभं याथना नरः ||
1.23.e: Fierce comes the Maruts’ thundering voice, like that of conquerors, when ye go  Forward to victory, O Men.

1.23.d: हस्काराद विद्युतस पर्यतो जाता अवन्तु नः | मरुतो मर्ळयन्तु नः ||
1.23.e: Born of the laughing lightning. may the Maruts guard us everywhere  May they be gracious unto Us.

1.23.d: आ पूषञ्चित्रबर्हिषमाघ्र्णे धरुणं दिवः | आजा नष्टं यथा पशुम ||
1.23.e: Like some lost animal, drive to us, bright Pūṣan, him who bears up heaven,  Resting on many-coloured grass.

1.23.d: पूषा राजानमाघ्र्णिरपगूळ्हं गुहा हितम | अविन्दच्चित्रबर्हिषम ||
1.23.e: Pūṣan the Bright has found the King, concealed and hidden in a cave,  Who rests on grass of many hues.

1.23.d: उतो स मह्यमिन्दुभिः षड युक्ताननुसेषिधत | गोभिर्यवं न चर्क्र्षत ||
1.23.e: And may he. duly bring to me the six bound closely, through these drops,  As one who ploughs with steers brings corn.

1.23.d: अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम | पर्ञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः ||
1.23.e: Along their paths the Mothers go, Sisters of priestly ministrants,  Mingling their sweetness with the milk.

1.23.d: अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह | ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम ||
1.23.e: May Waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined,  Speed forth this sacrifice of ours.

1.23.d: अपो देवीरुप हवये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः | सिन्दुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः ||
1.23.e: I call the Waters, Goddesses, wherein our cattle quench their thirst;  Oblations to the Streams be given.

1.23.d: अप्स्वन्तरम्र्तमप्सु भेषजमपामुत परशस्तये | देवाभवत वाजिनः ||
1.23.e: Amrit is in the Waters in the Waters there is healing balm  Be swift, ye Gods, to give them praise.

1.23.d: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा | अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवमापश्च विश्वभेषजीः ||
1.23.e: Within the Waters—Soma thus hath told me—dwell all balms that heal,  And Agni, he who blesseth all. The Waters hold all medicines.

1.23.d: आपः पर्णीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम | जयोक च सूर्यं दर्शे ||
1.23.e: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm,  So that I long may see the Sun.

1.23.d: इदमापः पर वहत यत किं च दुरितं मयि | यद वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद वा शेप उतान्र्तम ||
1.23.e: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought.  If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

1.23.d: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि | पयस्वानग्न आगहि तं मा सं सर्ज वर्चसा ||
1.23.e: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come:  O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

1.23.d: सं माग्ने वर्चसा सर्ज सं परजया समायुषा | विद्युर्मेस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात सह रषिभिः ||
1.23.e: Fill me with splendour, Agni; give offspring and length of days; the Gods  Shall know me even as I am, and Indra with the Ṛṣis, know.

1.24.d: कस्य नूनं कतमस्याम्र्तानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम | को नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात पितरं च दर्शेयं मातरं च ||
1.24.e: WHO now is he, what God among Immortals, of whose auspicious name we may bethink us?  Who shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother?

1.24.d: अग्नेर्वयं परथमस्याम्र्तानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम | स नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात पितरं च दर्शेयं मातरं च ||
1.24.e: Agni the God the first among the Immortals,—of his auspicious name let us bethink us.  He shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother.

1.24.d: अभि तवा देव सवितरीशानं वार्याणाम | सदावन भागमीमहे ||
1.24.e: To thee, O Savitar, the Lord of precious things, who helpest us  Continually, for our share we come—

1.24.d: यश्चिद धि त इत्था भगः शशमानः पुरा निदः | अद्वेषो हस्तयोर्दधे ||
1.24.e: Wealth, highly lauded ere reproach hath fallen on it, which is laid,  Free from all hatred, in thy hands

1.24.d: भगभक्तस्य ते वयमुदशेम तवावसा | मूर्धानं राय आरभे ||
1.24.e: Through thy protection may we come to even the height of affluence  Which Bhaga hath dealt out to us.

1.24.d: नहि ते कषत्रं न सहो न मन्युं वयश्चनामी पतयन्त आपुः | नेमा आपो अनिमिषं चरन्तीर्न ये वातस्य परमिनन्त्यभ्वम ||
1.24.e: Ne’er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit;  Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.

1.24.d: अबुध्ने राजा वरुणो वनस्योर्ध्वं सतूपं ददते पूतदक्षः | नीचीना सथुरुपरि बुध्न एषामस्मे अन्तर्निहिताःकेतवः सयुः ||
1.24.e: Varuṇa, King, of hallowed might, sustaineth erect the Tree's stem in the baseless region.  Its rays, whose root is high above, stream downward. Deep may they sink within us, and be hidden.

1.24.d: उरुं हि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्याय पन्थामन्वेतवा उ | अपदे पादा परतिधातवे.अकरुतापवक्ता हर्दयाविधश्चित ||
1.24.e: King Varuṇa hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel.  Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate’er afflicts the spirit.

1.24.d: शतं ते राजन भिषजः सहस्रमुर्वी गभीरा सुमतिष टे अस्तु | बाधस्व दूरे निरतिं पराचैः कर्तं चिदेनः पर मुमुग्ध्यस्मत ||
1.24.e: A hundred balms are thine, O King, a thousand; deep and wide-reaching also be thy favours.  Far from us, far away drive thou Destruction. Put from us e’en the sin we have committed.

1.24.d: अमी य रक्षा निहितास उच्चा नक्तं दद्र्श्रे कुह चिद दिवेयुः | अदब्धानि वरुणस्य वरतानि विचाकशच्चन्द्रमा नक्तमेति ||
1.24.e: Whither by day depart the constellations that shine at night, set high in heaven above us?  Varuṇa's holy laws remain unweakened, and through the night the Moon moves on in splendor

1.24.d: तत तवा यामि बरह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः | अहेळमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुःप्र मोषीः ||
1.24.e: I ask this of thee with my prayer adoring; thy worshipper craves this with his oblation.  Varuṇa, stay thou here and be not angry; steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.

1.24.d: तदिन नक्तं तद दिवा मह्यमाहुस्तदयं केतो हर्द आ वि चष्टे | शुनःशेपो यमह्वद गर्भीतः सो अस्मान राजा वरुणो मुमोक्तु ||
1.24.e: Nightly and daily this one thing they tell me, this too the thought of mine own heart repeateth.  May he to whom prayed fettered Śunaḥśepa, may he the Sovran Varuṇa release us.

1.24.d: शुनःशेपो हयह्वद गर्भीतस्त्रिष्वादित्यं दरुपदेषु बद्धः | अवैनं राजा वरुणः सस्र्ज्याद विद्वानदब्धो वि मुमोक्तु पाशान ||
1.24.e: Bound to three pillars captured Śunaḥśepa thus to the Āditya made his supplication.  Him may the Sovran Varuṇa deliver, wise, ne’er deceived, loosen the bonds that bind him.

1.24.d: अव ते हेळो वरुण नमोभिरव यज्ञेभिरीमहे हविर्भिः | कषयन्नस्मभ्यमसुर परचेता राजन्नेनांसि शिश्रथः कर्तानि ||
1.24.e: With bending down, oblations, sacrifices, O Varuṇa, we deprecate thine anger:  Wise Asura, thou King of wide dominion, loosen the bonds of sins by us committed.

1.24.d: उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं शरथाय | अथा वयमादित्य वरते तवानागसो अदितये सयाम ||
1.24.e: Loosen the bonds, O Varuṇa, that hold me, loosen the bonds above, between, and under.  So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Āditya.

1.25.d: यच्चिद धि ते विशो यथा पर देव वरुण वरतम | मिनीमसिद्यवि-दयवि ||
1.25.e: WHATEVER law of thine, O God, O Varuṇa, as we are men,  Day after day we violate.

1.25.d: मा नो वधाय हत्नवे जिहीळानस्य रीरधः | मा हर्णानस्य मन्यवे ||
1.25.e: give us not as a prey to death, to be destroyed by thee in wrath,  To thy fierce anger when displeased.

1.25.d: वि मर्ळीकाय ते मनो रथीरश्वं न सन्दितम | गीर्भिर्वरुण सीमहि ||
1.25.e: To gain thy mercy, Varuṇa, with hymns we bind thy heart, as binds  The charioteer his tethered horse.

1.25.d: परा हि मे विमन्यवः पतन्ति वस्यैष्टये | वयो न वसतीरुप ||
1.25.e: They flee from me dispirited, bent only on obtaining wealth,  As to their nests the birds of air.

1.25.d: कदा कषत्रश्रियं नरमा वरुणं करामहे | मर्ळीकायोरुचक्षसम ||
1.25.e: When shall we bring, to be appeased, the Hero, Lord of warrior might,  Him, the far-seeing Varuṇa?

1.25.d: तदित समानमाशाते वेनन्ता न पर युछतः | धर्तव्रताय दाशुषे ||
1.25.e: This, this with joy they both accept in common: never do they fail  The ever-faithful worshipper.

1.25.d: वेदा यो वीनां पदमन्तरिक्षेण पतताम | वेद नावः समुद्रियः ||
1.25.e: He knows the path of birds that fly through heaven, and, Sovran of the sea,  He knows the ships that are thereon.

1.25.d: वेद मासो धर्तव्रतो दवादश परजावतः | वेदा य उपजायते ||
1.25.e: True to his holy law, he knows the twelve moons with their progeny:  He knows the moon of later birth.

1.25.d: वेद वातस्य वर्तनिमुरोर्र्ष्वस्य बर्हतः | वेदा ये अध्यासते ||
1.25.e: He knows the pathway of the wind, the spreading, high, and mighty wind:  He knows the Gods who dwell above.

1.25.d: नि षसाद धर्तव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्यास्वा | साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः ||
1.25.e: Varuṇa, true to holy law, sits down among his people; he,  Most wise, sits there to govern all.

1.25.d: अतो विश्वान्यद्भुता चिकित्वानभि पश्यति | कर्तानि या चकर्त्वा ||
1.25.e: From thence  perceiving  he beholds all wondrous things, both what hath been,  And what hereafter will be done.

1.25.d: स नो विश्वाहा सुक्रतुरादित्यः सुपथा करत | पर ण आयूंषि तारिषत ||
1.25.e: May that Āditya, very wise, make fair paths for us all our days:  May he prolong our lives for us.

1.25.d: बिभ्रद दरापिं हिरण्ययं वरुणो वस्त निर्णिजम | परि सपशो नि षेदिरे ||
1.25.e: Varuṇa, wearing golden mail, hath clad him in a shining robe.  His spies are seated found about.

1.25.d: न यं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवो न दरुह्वाणो जनानाम | न देवमभिमातयः ||
1.25.e: The God whom enemies threaten not, nor those who tyrannize o’er men,  Nor those whose minds are bent on wrong.

1.25.d: उत यो मानुषेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या | अस्माकमुदरेष्वा ||
1.25.e: He who gives glory to mankind, not glory that is incomplete,  To our own bodies giving it.

1.25.d: परा मे यन्ति धीतयो गावो न गव्यूतीरनु | इछन्तीरुरुचक्षसम ||
1.25.e: Yearning for the wide-seeing One, my thoughts move onward unto him,  As kine unto their pastures move.

1.25.d: सं नु वोचावहै पुनर्यतो मे मध्वाभ्र्तम | होतेव कषदसे परियम ||
1.25.e: Once more together let us speak, because my meath is brought: priest-like  Thou eatest what is dear to thee.

1.25.d: दर्शं नु विश्वदर्षतं दर्शं रथमधि कषमि | एता जुषत मे गिरः ||
1.25.e: Now saw I him whom all may see, I saw his car above the earth:  He hath accepted these my songs.

1.25.d: इमं मे वरुण शरुधी हवमद्या च मर्ळय | तवामवस्युरा चके ||
1.25.e: Varuṇa, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day  Longing for help I cried to thee.

1.25.d: तवं विश्वस्य मेधिर दिवश्च गमश्च राजसि | स यामनिप्रति शरुधि ||
1.25.e: Thou, O wise God, art Lord of all, thou art the King of earth and heaven  Hear, as thou goest on thy way.

1.25.d: उदुत्तमं मुमुग्धि नो वि पाशं मध्यमं चर्त | अवाधमानि जीवसे ||
1.25.e: Release us from the upper bond, untie the bond between, and loose  The bonds below, that I may live.

1.26.d: वसिष्वा हि मियेध्य वस्त्राण्यूर्जां पते | सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ||
1.26.e: O WORTHY of oblation, Lord of prospering powers, assume thy robes,  And offer this our sacrifice.

1.26.d: नि नो होता वरेण्यः सदा यविष्ठ मन्मभिः | अग्ने दिवित्मता वचः ||
1.26.e: Sit ever to be chosen, as our Priest, most youthful, through our hymns,  O Agni, through our heavenly word.

1.26.d: आ नि षमा सूनवे पितापिर्यजत्यापये | सखा सख्ये वरेण्यः ||
1.26.e: For here a Father for his son, Kinsman for kinsman worshippeth,  And Friend, choice-worthy, for his friend.

1.26.d: आ नो बर्ही रिशादसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा | सीदन्तु मनुषो यथा ||
1.26.e: Here let the foe-destroyers sit, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman,  Like men, upon our sacred grass.

1.26.d: पूर्व्य होतरस्य नो मन्दस्व सख्यस्य च | इमा उ षु शरुधी गिरः ||
1.26.e: O ancient Herald, be thou glad in this our rite and fellowship:  Hearken thou well to these our songs.

1.26.d: यच्चिद धि शश्वता तना देवं-देवं यजामहे | तवे इद्धूयते हविः ||
1.26.e: Whate’er in this perpetual course we sacrifice to God and God,  That gift is offered up in thee

1.26.d: परियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः | परियाः सवग्नयो वयम ||
1.26.e: May he be our dear household Lord, Priest, pleasant and, choice-worthy may  We, with bright fires, be dear to him.

1.26.d: सवग्नयो हि वार्यं देवासो दधिरे च नः | सवग्नयो मनामहे ||
1.26.e: The Gods, adored with brilliant fires. have granted precious wealth to us  So, with bright fires, we pray to thee.

1.26.d: अथा न उभयेषामम्र्त मर्त्यानाम | मिथः सन्तु परशस्तयः ||
1.26.e: And, O Immortal One, so may the eulogies of mortal men  Belong to us and thee alike.

1.26.d: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः | चनो धाः सहसो यहो ||
1.26.e: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice,  And this our speech, O Son of Strength.

1.27.d: अश्वं न तवा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः | सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम ||
1.27.e: WITH worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed,  Imperial Lord of sacred rites.

1.27.d: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पर्थुप्रगामा सुशेवः | मीढ्वानस्माकं बभूयात ||
1.27.e: May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity,  Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.

1.27.d: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः | पाहि सदमिद विश्वायुः ||
1.27.e: Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore  Protect us from the sinful man.

1.27.d: इममू षु तवमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसम | अग्ने देवेषु पर वोचः ||
1.27.e: O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods,  And this our newest song of praise.

1.27.d: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु | शिक्षा वस्वोन्तमस्य ||
1.27.e: Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below,  A share of strength that is between.

1.27.d: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ | सद्यो दाशुषे कषरसि ||
1.27.e: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou  Swift streamest to the worshipper.

1.27.d: यमग्ने पर्त्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः | स यन्ताशश्वतीरिषः ||
1.27.e: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight,  Agni, or urgest to the fray.

1.27.d: नकिरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित | वाजो अस्ति शरवाय्यः ||
1.27.e: Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One:  Nay, very glorious power is his.

1.27.d: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता | विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ||
1.27.e: May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight,  And with the singers win the spoil.

1.27.d: जराबोध तद विविड्ढि विशे-विशे यज्ञियाय | सतोमं रुद्राय दर्शीकम ||
1.27.e: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him  Adorable in every house.

1.27.d: स नो महाननिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः | धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ||
1.27.e: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright,  Urge us to strength and holy thought.

1.27.d: स रेवानिव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शर्णोतु नः | उक्थैरग्निर्ब्र्हद्भानुः ||
1.27.e: Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods,  Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.

1.27.d: नमो महद्भ्यो नमो अर्भकेभ्यो नमो युवभ्यो नम आशिनेभ्यः | यजाम देवान यदि शक्नवाम मा जयायसः शंसमा वर्क्षि देवाः ||
1.27.e: Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder!  Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.

1.28.d: यत्र गरावा पर्थुबुध्न ऊर्ध्वो भवति सोतवे | उलूखलसुतानामवेद विन्द्र जल्गुलः ||
1.28.e: THERE where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out,  O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

1.28.d: यत्र दवाविव जघनाधिषवण्या कर्ता | उलूखलसुतानामवेद विन्द्र जल्गुलः ||
1.28.e: Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid,  O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

1.28.d: यत्र नार्यपच्यवमुपच्यवं च शिक्षते | उलूखलसुतानामवेद विन्द्र जल्गुलः ||
1.28.e: There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall,  O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

1.28.d: यत्र मन्थां विबध्नते रश्मीन यमितवा इव | उलूखलसुतानामवेद विन्द्र जल्गुलः ||
1.28.e: Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords,  O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

1.28.d: यच्चिद धि तवं गर्हेग्र्ह उलूखलक युज्यसे | इह दयुमत्तमं वद यजतामिव दुन्दुभिः ||
1.28.e: If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work,  Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.

1.28.d: उत सम ते वनस्पते वातो वि वात्यग्रमित | अथो इन्द्राय पातवे सुनु सोममुलूखल ||
1.28.e: O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee,  Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.

1.28.d: आयजी वाजसातमा ता हयुच्चा विजर्भ्र्तः | हरी इवान्धांसि बप्सता ||
1.28.e: Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements,  Like two bay horses champing herbs.

1.28.d: ता नो अद्य वनस्पती रष्वाव रष्वेभिः सोत्र्भिः | इन्द्राय मधुमत सुतम ||
1.28.e: Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day  Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.

1.28.d: उच्छिष्टं चम्वोर्भर सोमं पवित्र आ सर्ज | नि धेहि गोरधि तवचि ||
1.28.e: Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour,  and on the ox-hide set the dregs.

1.29.d: यच्चिद धि सत्य सोमपा अनाशस्ता इव समसि | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be,  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.29.d: शिप्रिन वाजानां पते शचीवस्तव दंसना | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful:  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.29.d: नि षवापया मिथूद्र्शा सस्तामबुध्यमाने | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.29.d: ससन्तु तया अरातयो बोधन्तु शूर रातयः | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake:  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.29.d: समिन्द्र गर्दभं मर्ण नुवन्तं पापयामुया | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee:  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.29.d: पताति कुण्ड्र्णाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course!  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine,  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.29.d: सर्वं परिक्रोशं जहि जम्भया कर्कदाश्वम | आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु सुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ||
1.29.e: Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us:  Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine  In thousands, O most wealthy One.

1.30.d: आ व इन्द्रं करिविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम | मंहिष्ठं सिञ्च इन्दुभिः ||
1.30.e: WE seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well,  Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,

1.30.d: शतं वा यः शुचीनां सहस्रं वा समाशिराम | एदु निम्नं न रीयते ||
1.30.e: Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts  Flow, even as down a depth, to him;

1.30.d: सं यन मदाय शुष्मिण एना हयस्योदरे | समुद्रो न वयचो दधे ||
1.30.e: When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room  Within his belly, like the sea.

1.30.d: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम | वचस्तच्चिन न ओहसे ||
1.30.e: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate:  Thou carest too for this our prayer.

1.30.d: सतोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते | विभूतिरस्तुसून्र्ता ||
1.30.e: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness  Be his who sings the laud to thee.

1.30.d: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतये.अस्मिन वाजे शतक्रतो | समन्येषु बरवावहै ||
1.30.e: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight  In others too let us agree.

1.30.d: योगे-योगे तवस्तरं वाजे-वाजे हवामहे | सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ||
1.30.e: In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us  Indra the mightiest of all.

1.30.d: आ घा गमद यदि शरवत सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः | वाजेभिरुप नो हवम ||
1.30.e: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds,  And all that strengthens, to our call.

1.30.d: अनु परत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम | यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ||
1.30.e: I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home,  Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

1.30.d: तं तवा वयं विश्ववारा शास्महे पुरुहूत | सखे वसो जरित्र्भ्यः ||
1.30.e: We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all precious gifts, O Friend,  Kind God to those who sing thy praise.

1.30.d: अस्माकं शिप्रिणीनां सोमपाः सोमपाव्नाम | सखे वज्रिन सखीनाम ||
1.30.e: O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames  And of our Soma-drinking friends.

1.30.d: तथा तदस्तु सोमपाः सखे वज्रिन तथा कर्णु | यथा त उश्मसीष्टये ||
1.30.e: Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act  To aid each wish as we desire.

1.30.d: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः | कषुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ||
1.30.e: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith,  Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.

1.30.d: आ घ तवावान तमनाप्त सतोत्र्भ्यो धर्ष्णवियानः | रणोरक्षं न चक्र्योह ||
1.30.e: Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought,  Bold One, the axle of the car.

1.30.d: आ यद दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम | रणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ||
1.30.e: That, Śatakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were,  Stirrest the axle with thy strength.

1.30.d: शश्वदिन्द्रः पोप्रुथद्भिर्जिगाय नानदद्भिः शाश्वसद्भिर्धनानि | स नो हिरण्यरथं दंसनावान स नः सनिता सनये स नो.अदात ||
1.30.e: With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures  A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.

1.30.d: आश्विनावश्वावत्येषा यतं शवीरया गोमद दस्रा हिरण्यवत ||
1.30.e: Come, Aśvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine,  And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.

1.30.d: समानयोजनो हि वां रथो दस्रावमर्त्यः | समुद्रे अश्विनेयते ||
1.30.e: Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts,  Travels, O Aśvins, in the sea.

1.30.d: वयघ्न्यस्य मूर्धनि चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः | परि दयामन्यदीयते ||
1.30.e: High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep,  The other round the sky revolves.

1.30.d: कस्त उषः कधप्रिये भुजे मर्तो अमर्त्ये | कं नक्षसे विभावरि ||
1.30.e: What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou?  To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?

1.30.d: वयं हि ते अमन्मह्यान्तादा पराकात | अश्वे न चित्रे अरुषि ||
1.30.e: For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away,  Red-hued and like a dappled mare.

1.30.d: तवं तयेभिरा गहि वाजेभिर्दुहितर्दिवः | अस्मे रयिं निधारय ||
1.30.e: Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings,  And send thou riches down to us.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने परथमो अङगिरा रषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा | तव वरते कवयो विद्मनापसो.अजायन्त मरुतो भराजद्र्ष्टयः ||
1.31.e: Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Aṅgiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods’ auspicious Friend.  After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने परथमो अङगिरस्तमः कविर्देवानां परि भूषसिव्रतम | विभुर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय मेधिरो दविमाता शयुः कतिधा चिदायवे ||
1.31.e: O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Aṅgiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods.  Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने परथमो मातरिश्वन आविर्भव सुक्रतूया विवस्वते | अरेजेतां रोदसी होत्र्वूर्ये.असघ्नोर्भारमयजो महोवसो ||
1.31.e: To Mātariśvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvān through thy noble inward power.  Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने मनवे दयामवाशयः पुरूरवसे सुक्र्ते सुक्र्त्तरः | शवात्रेण यत पित्रोर्मुच्यसे पर्या तवा पूर्वमनयन्नापरं पुनः ||
1.31.e: Agni thou madest heaven to thunder for mankind; thou, yet more pious, for pious Purūravas.  When thou art rapidly freed from thy parents, first eastward they bear thee round, and, after, to the west.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने वर्षभः पुष्टिवर्धन उद्यतस्रुचे भवसि शरवाय्यः | य आहुतिं परि वेदा वषट्क्र्तिमेकायुरग्रे विश आविवाससि ||
1.31.e: Thou, Agni, art a Bull who makes our store increase, to be invoked by him who lifts the ladle up.  Well knowing the oblation with the hallowing word, uniting all who live, thou lightenest first our folk

1.31.d: तवमग्ने वर्जिनवर्तनिं नरं सक्मन पिपर्षि विदथे विचर्षणे | यः शूरसाता परितक्म्ये धने दभ्रेभिश्चित सम्र्ताहंसि भूयसः ||
1.31.e: Agni, thou savest in the synod when pursued e’en him, farseeing One! who walks in evil ways.  Thou, when the heroes fight for spoil which men rush, round, slayest in war the many by the hands of few.

1.31.d: तवं तमग्ने अम्र्तत्व उत्तमे मर्तं दधासि शरवसे दिवे दिवे | यस्तात्र्षाण उभयाय जन्मने मयः कर्णोषि परया च सूरये ||
1.31.e: For glory, Agni, day by day, thou liftest up the mortal man to highest immortality,  Even thou who yearning for both races givest them great bliss, and to the prince grantest abundant food.

1.31.d: तवं नो अग्ने सनये धनानां यशसं कारुं कर्णुहि सतवानः | रध्याम कर्मापसा नवेन देवैर्द्यावाप्र्थिवी परावतं नः ||
1.31.e: O Agni, highly lauded, make our singer famous that he may win us store of riches:  May we improve the rite with new performance. O Earth and Heaven, with all the Gods, protect us.

1.31.d: तवं नो अग्ने पित्रोरुपस्थ आ देवो देवेष्वनवद्य जाग्र्विः | तनूक्र्द बोधि परमतिश्च कारवे तवं कल्याण वसु विश्वमोपिषे ||
1.31.e: O blameless Agni lying in thy Parents' lap, a God among the Gods, be watchful for our good.  Former of bodies, be the singer's Providence: all good things hast thou sown for him, auspicious One!

1.31.d: तवमग्ने परमतिस्त्वं पितासि नस्त्वं वयस्क्र्त तव जामयो वयम | सं तवा रायः शतिनः सं सहस्रिणः सुवीरं यन्ति वरतपामदाभ्य ||
1.31.e: Agni, thou art our Providence, our Father thou: we are thy brethren and thou art our spring of life.  In thee, rich in good heroes, guard of high decrees, meet hundred, thousand treasures, O infallible!

1.31.d: तवामग्ने परथममायुमायवे देवा अक्र्ण्वन नहुषस्य विश्पतिम | इळामक्र्ण्वन मनुषस्य शासनीं पितुर्यत पुत्रो ममकस्य जायते ||
1.31.e: Thee, Agni, have the Gods made the first living One for living man, Lord of the house of Nahuṣa.  Iḷā they made the teacher of the sons of men, what time a Son was born to the father of my race.

1.31.d: तवं नो अग्ने तव देव पायुभिर्मघोनो रक्ष तन्वश्च वन्द्य | तराता तोकस्य तनये गवामस्यनिमेषं रक्षमाणस्तव वरते ||
1.31.e: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves.  Guard of our seed art thou, aiding our cows to bear, incessantly protecting in thy holy way.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने यज्यवे पायुरन्तरो.अनिषङगाय चतुरक्ष इध्यसे | यो रातहव्यो.अव्र्काय धायसे कीरेश्चिन मन्त्रं मनसावनोषि तम ||
1.31.e: Agni, thou art a guard close to the pious man; kindled art thou, four-eyed! for him who is unarmed.  With fond heart thou acceptest e’en the poor man's prayer, when he hath brought his gift to gain security.

1.31.d: तवमग्न उरुशंसाय वाघते सपार्हं यद रेक्णः परमं वनोषि तत | आध्रस्य चित परमतिरुच्यसे पिता पर पाकंशास्सि पर दिशो विदुष्टरः ||
1.31.e: Thou, Agni gainest for the loudly-praising priest the highest wealth, the object of a man's desire.  Thou art called Father, caring even for the weak, and wisest, to the simple one thou teachest lore.

1.31.d: तवमग्ने परयतदक्षिणं नरं वर्मेव सयूतं परि पासि विश्वतः | सवादुक्षद्मा यो वसतौ सयोनक्र्ज्जीवयाजं यजते सोपमा दिवः ||
1.31.e: Agni, the man who giveth guerdon to the priests, like well-sewn armour thou guardest on every side.  He who with grateful food shows kindness in his house, an offerer to the living, is the type of heaven.

1.31.d: इमामग्ने शरणिं मीम्र्षो न इममध्वानं यमगाम दूरात | आपिः पिता परमतिः सोम्यानां भर्मिरस्य रषिक्र्न मर्त्यानाम ||
1.31.e: Pardon, we pray, this sin of ours, O Agni,—the path which we have trodden, widely straying,  Dear Friend and Father, caring for the pious, who speedest nigh and who inspirest mortals.

1.31.d: मनुष्वदग्ने अङगिरस्वदङगिरो ययातिवत सदने पूर्ववच्छुचे | अछ याह्या वहा दैव्यं जनमा सादय बर्हिषि यक्षि च परियम ||
1.31.e: As erst to Manus, to Yayāti, Aṅgiras, so Aṅgiras! pure Agni! come thou to our hall.  Bring hither the celestial host and seat them here upon the sacred grass, and offer what they love.

1.31.d: एतेनाग्ने बरह्मणा वाव्र्धस्व शक्ती वा यत ते चक्र्मा विदा वा | उत पर णेष्यभि वस्यो अस्मान सं नः सर्ज सुमत्या वाजवत्या ||
1.31.e: By this our prayer be thou, O Agni, strengthened, prayer made by us after our power and knowledge.  Lead thou us, therefore, to increasing riches; endow us with thy strength-bestowing favour.

1.32.d: इन्द्रस्य नु वीर्याणि पर वोचं यानि चकार परथमानि वज्री | अहन्नहिमन्वपस्ततर्द पर वक्षणा अभिनत पर्वतानाम ||
1.32.e: I WILL declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder.  He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

1.32.d: अहन्नहिं पर्वते शिश्रियाणं तवष्टास्मै वज्रं सवर्यं ततक्ष | वाश्रा इव धेनवः सयन्दमाना अञ्जः समुद्रमव जग्मुरापः ||
1.32.e: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvaṣṭar fashioned.  Like lowing kine in rapid flow descending the waters glided downward to the ocean.

1.32.d: वर्षायमाणो.अव्र्णीत सोमं तरिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत सुतस्य | आसायकं मघवादत्त वज्रमहन्नेनं परथमजामहीनाम ||
1.32.e: Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma and in three sacred beakers drank the juices.  Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.

1.32.d: यदिन्द्राहन परथमजामहीनामान मायिनाममिनाः परोत मायाः | आत सूर्यं जनयन दयामुषासं तादीत्नाशत्रुं न किला विवित्से ||
1.32.e: When, Indra, thou hadst slain the dragon's firstborn, and overcome the charms of the enchanters,  Then, giving life to Sun and Dawn and Heaven, thou foundest not one foe to stand against thee.

1.32.d: अहन वर्त्रं वर्त्रतरं वयंसमिन्द्रो वज्रेण महता वधेन | सकन्धांसीव कुलिशेना विव्र्क्णाहिः शयत उपप्र्क पर्थिव्याः ||
1.32.e: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛtra, worst of Vṛtras.  As trunks of trees, what time the axe hath felled them, low on the earth so lies the prostrate Dragon.

1.32.d: अयोद्धेव दुर्मद आ हि जुह्वे महावीरं तुविबाधं रजीषम | नातारीदस्य सम्र्तिं वधानां सं रुजानाः पिपिषैन्द्रशत्रुः ||
1.32.e: He, like a mad weak warrior, challenged Indra, the great impetuous many-slaying Hero.  He, brooking not the clashing of the weapons, crushed—Indra's foe—the shattered forts in falling.

1.32.d: अपादहस्तो अप्र्तन्यदिन्द्रमास्य वज्रमधि सानौ जघान | वर्ष्णो वध्रिः परतिमानं बुभूषन पुरुत्रा वर्त्रो अशयद वयस्तः ||
1.32.e: Footless and handless still he challenged Indra, who smote him with his bolt between the shoulders.  Emasculate yet claiming manly vigour, thus Vṛtra lay with scattered limbs dissevered.

1.32.d: नदं न भिन्नममुया शयानं मनो रुहाणा अति यन्त्यापः | याश्चिद वर्त्रो महिना पर्यतिष्ठत तासामहिः पत्सुतःशीर्बभूव ||
1.32.e: There as he lies like a bank-bursting river, the waters taking courage flow above him.  The Dragon lies beneath the feet of torrents which Vṛtra with his greatness had encompassed.

1.32.d: नीचावया अभवद वर्त्रपुत्रेन्द्रो अस्या अव वधर्जभार | उत्तरा सूरधरः पुत्र आसीद दानुः शये सहवत्सा न धेनुः ||
1.32.e: Then humbled was the strength of Vṛtra's mother: Indra hath cast his deadly bolt against her.  The mother was above, the son was under and like a cow beside her calf lay Danu.

1.32.d: अतिष्ठन्तीनामनिवेशनानां काष्ठानां मध्ये निहितंशरीरम | वर्त्रस्य निण्यं वि चरन्त्यापो दीर्घं तम आशयदिन्द्रशत्रुः ||
1.32.e: Rolled in the midst of never-ceasing currents flowing without a rest for ever onward.  The waters bear off Vṛtra's nameless body: the foe of Indra sank to during darkness.

1.32.d: दासपत्नीरहिगोपा अतिष्ठन निरुद्धा आपः पणिनेव गावः | अपां बिलमपिहितं यदासीद वर्त्रं जघन्वानपतद ववार ||
1.32.e: Guarded by Ahi stood the thralls of Dāsas, the waters stayed like kine held by the robber.  But he, when he had smitten Vṛtra, opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.

1.32.d: अश्व्यो वारो अभवस्तदिन्द्र सर्के यत तवा परत्यहन देव एकः | अजयो गा अजयः शूर सोममवास्र्जः सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून ||
1.32.e: A horse's tail wast thou when he, O Indra, smote on thy bolt; thou, God without a second,  Thou hast won back the kine, hast won the Soma; thou hast let loose to flow the Seven Rivers.

1.32.d: नास्मै विद्युन न तन्यतुः सिषेध न यां मिहमकिरद धरादुनिं च | इन्द्रश्च यद युयुधाते अहिश्चोतापरीभ्यो मघवा वि जिग्ये ||
1.32.e: Nothing availed him lightning, nothing thunder, hailstorm or mist which had spread around him:  When Indra and the Dragon strove in battle, Maghavan gained the victory for ever.

1.32.d: अहेर्यातारं कमपश्य इन्द्र हर्दि यत ते जघ्नुषो भीरगछत | नव च यन नवतिं च सरवन्तीः शयेनो न भीतोतरो रजांसि ||
1.32.e: Whom sawest thou to avenge the Dragon, Indra, that fear possessed thy heart when thou hadst slain him;  That, like a hawk affrighted through the regions, thou crossedst nine-and-ninety flowing rivers?

1.32.d: इन्द्रो यातो.अवसितस्य राजा शमस्य च शर्ङगिणो वज्रबाहुः | सेदु राजा कषयति चर्षणीनामरान न नेमिः परि ता बभूव ||
1.32.e: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder.  Over all living men he rules as Sovran, containing all as spokes within the felly.

1.33.d: एतायामोप गव्यन्त इन्द्रमस्माकं सु परमतिं वाव्र्धाति | अनाम्र्णः कुविदादस्य रायो गवां केतं परमावर्जते नः ||
1.33.e: Come, fain for booty let us seek to Indra: yet more shall he increase his care that guides us.  Will not the Indestructible endow us with perfect knowledge of this wealth, of cattle?

1.33.d: उपेदहं धनदामप्रतीतं जुष्टं न शयेनो वसतिम्पतामि | इन्द्रं नमस्यन्नुपमेभिरर्कैर्यः सतोत्र्भ्यो हव्यो अस्ति यामन ||
1.33.e: I fly to him invisible Wealth-giver as flies the falcon to his cherished eyrie,  With fairest hymns of praise adoring Indra, whom those who laud him must invoke in battle.

1.33.d: नि सर्वसेन इषुधीन्रसक्त समर्यो गा अजति यस्य वष्टि | चोष्कूयमाण इन्द्र भूरि वामं मा पणिर्भूरस्मदधि परव्र्द्ध ||
1.33.e: Mid all his host, he bindeth on the quiver: he driveth cattle from what foe he pleaseth:  Gathering up great store of riches, Indra. be thou no trafficker with us, most mighty.

1.33.d: वधीर्हि दस्युं धनिनं घनेननेकश्चरन्नुपशाकेभिरिन्द्र | धनोरधि विषुणक ते वयायन्नयज्वनः सनकाः परेतिमीयुः ||
1.33.e: Thou slewest with thy bolt the wealthy Dasyu, alone, yet going with thy helpers, Indra!  Far from the floor of heaven in all directions, the ancient riteless ones fled to destruction.

1.33.d: परा चिच्छीर्षा वव्र्जुस्त इन्द्रायज्वानो यज्वभिः सपर्धमानाः | पर यद दिवो हरिव सथातरुग्र निरव्रतानधमोरोदस्योः ||
1.33.e: Fighting with pious worshippers, the riteless turned and fled, Indra! with averted faces.  When thou, fierce Lord of the Bay Steeds, the Stayer, blewest from earth and heaven and sky the godless.

1.33.d: अयुयुत्सन्ननवद्यस्य सेनामयातयन्त कषितयो नवग्वाः | वर्षायुधो न वध्रयो निरष्टाः परवद्भिरिन्द्राच्चितयन्त आयन ||
1.33.e: They met in fight the army of the blameless: then the Navagvas put forth all their power.  They, like emasculates with men contending, fled, conscious, by steep paths from Indra, scattered.

1.33.d: तवमेतान रुदतो जक्षतश्चायोधयो रजस इन्द्र पारे | अवादहो दिव आ दस्युमुच्चा पर सुन्वतः सतुवतः शंसमावः ||
1.33.e: Whether they weep or laugh, thou hast o’erthrown them, O Indra, on the sky's extremest limit.  The Dasyu thou hast burned from heaven, and welcomed the prayer of him who pours the juice and lauds thee.

1.33.d: चक्राणासः परीणहं पर्थिव्या हिरण्येन मणिना शुम्भमानाः | न हिन्वानासस्तितिरुस्त इन्द्रं परि सपशो अदधात सूर्येण ||
1.33.e: Adorned with their array of gold and jewels, they o’er the earth a covering veil extended.  Although they hastened, they o’ercame not Indra: their spies he compassed with the Sun of morning.

1.33.d: परि यदिन्द्र रोदसी उभे अबुभोजीर्महिना विश्वतः सीम | अमन्यमानानभि मन्यमानैर्निर्ब्रह्मभिरधमो दस्युमिन्द्र ||
1.33.e: As thou enjoyest heaven and earth, O Indra, on every side surrounded with thy greatness,  So thou with priests hast blown away the Dasyu, and those who worship not with those who worship.

1.33.d: न ये दिवः पर्थिव्या अन्तमापुर्न मायाभिर्धनदां पर्यभूवन | युजं वज्रं वर्षभश्चक्र इन्द्रो निर्ज्योतिषा तमसो गा अदुक्षत ||
1.33.e: They who pervaded earth's extremest limit subdued not with their charms the Wealth-bestower:  Indra, the Bull, made his ally the thunder, and with its light milked cows from out the darkness.

1.33.d: अनु सवधामक्षरन्नापो अस्यावर्धत मध्य आ नाव्यानाम | सध्रीचीनेन मनसा तमिन्द्र ओजिष्ठेन हन्मनाहन्नभि दयून ||
